name: Bike share (6 stations and a van)
description: Two weeks of a city bike share, five minutes at a time, as the operator's dashboard saw them: how many bikes were docked at each of its six stations, and how many bikes were on board the rebalancing van. The fleet is 200 bikes. Nothing else is measured: no counters, no trip records, and nobody counts the bikes that are out on the street. The two weeks start on a Monday; one weekday it rained all day. The operator changed four things (each starts an era): a station got more docks, a station was closed for a day and then reopened, and the van's schedule changed. Start plays the two weeks live, five minutes per tick (Speed sets how fast); Import history loads them all at once. Then run Discover flows. A good discovery should say which stations bikes move between, how long a bike is away between leaving one station and docking at another, how many bikes are out at a time, and where the van takes bikes from and where it leaves them. The answer is in bikeshare/README.md; do not read it first.
